title: Remove an item from the cart page

story.iWant: to remove an item from the cart page
story.soThat: my cart holds only what I mean to buy

why: A shopper who cannot remove an item pays for something they did not want.
alreadyThere: The cart page has a Remove button on each item, and the header shows a cart badge.

criteria.when: the shopper clicks Remove on one
criteria.then: that item is no longer listed and the other still is
the cart is empty and the badge is not shown

criteria.given: a cart with one item that was removed
criteria.when: the shopper reloads the cart page
criteria.then: the removed item does not come back

assumptions: The badge is hidden when the cart is empty.
riskReason: Every purchase goes through the cart; a wrong count is visible but not blocking.

covered.test: removing an item in the cart leaves the others
